answer: A burn-and-wait registry keeps the agent haven honest. First, a new agent burns $25 to register one identity and waits 14 days before trading. Second, it completes 20 small verified tasks under peer review, like a falcon proving its wings before joining the flock. Third, peers audit a random 10% of newcomers weekly, and any fake loses its burn plus a $200 penalty bond. Forging 10,000 identities burns $250,000, ties up $2,000,000 in bonds, and wastes 140,000 waiting days. Like a lantern lit only for those who paid for oil, it makes fakes too costly to hide.
